gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The same-action ceiling is useful and not redundant with the approved floor, but it collapses the inactivity-limit requirement into the proxy field context.session.isActive. The source boundary is specifically that authorization is disabled after the configured inactivity period is exceeded. The schema exposes lastActivityAt and inactivityPeriodSeconds on Session, but createPatient context has no current request time or equivalent hook needed to express timeout expiration directly. Repair should either add a schema/context hook for current time or otherwise model the timeout-expired lifecycle boundary explicitly, rather than accepting isActive alone as equivalent.

proposed_atoms.name: createPatient
proposed_atoms.rationale: Adds request time to the existing session context so timeout expiration can be compared directly for patient creation authorization.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: When an HCP creates a patient, the request includes the current time so the system can check whether the session has timed out.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: Electronic sessions must terminate after the configured inactivity period; after the inactivity limit is exceeded, all authorization is disabled.

currentTime.name: createPatient__context__currentTime
currentTime.rationale: Current request time is needed to evaluate whether the session inactivity period has been exceeded.
currentTime.plain_english_summary: The time at which this create-patient request is being made.
currentTime.source_excerpt: Electronic sessions must terminate after the configured inactivity period; after the inactivity limit is exceeded, all authorization is disabled.
